fix: Load the JWT signing secret from an environment variable or secret manager and rotate the leaked value.
Use a parameterized query such as db.query("... LIKE $1", ['%' + q + '%']).
Resolve the path and verify it stays within REPORT_DIR (or use path.basename / sendFile with a root option) before sending.
Hash passwords with a slow salted algorithm such as argon2id, bcrypt or scrypt instead of MD5.
Validate the URL against an allowlist of schemes/hosts and block private, loopback and link-local addresses before fetching.
Add requireAdmin or an ownership check (e.g. AND owner_id = $2) so users can only delete permitted tickets.
Use execFile with an argument array and validate format against a fixed allowlist instead of interpolating into a shell string.
